Our 78 All-Time Best Christmas Cookie Recipes

Santa won't be the only one munching on these delectable treats.

By Samantha MacAvoy, Joy ChoUpdated: Oct 28, 2024

We've been independently researching and testing products for over 120 years. If you buy through our links, we may earn a commission. Learn more about our review process.

Christmas truly is the most wonderful time of year, filled with festive tunes, one-of-a-kind gifts and delicious holiday feasts. And what would the holidays be without sweet treats? That’s why we’ve gathered a fabulously festive roundup of our Test Kitchen editors' favorite Christmas cookie recipes to bake (and eat) this season.

Here, you'll find dozens of options for every taste and cookie box — from classics like gingerbread, sugar-dusted crescents and Italian Christmas cookies to inventive recipes featuring matcha, sesame and freeze-dried fruit for a pop of color. Chocolate lovers can indulge in gooey treats, and for those skipping the scooping and shaping, bar cookies are here to save the day. We've even included some jazzed-up store-bought options for when baking isn't in the cards.

Whether you're looking for a new treat for Santa, a holiday dessert to pair with your Christmas cocktail or a sweet addition to a holiday party, these Christmas cookie recipes are sure to delight.

1

Black Sesame Sablés

Packed with nutty sesame and malty rye, these delicate, earthy shortbread cookies will bring complexity to your cookie box. Use roasted sesame seeds for the greatest depth of flavor.

Get the Black Sesame Sablés recipe.

2

Italian Rainbow Cookies

Also called Venetians or tricolores, these jam-layered, almond-scented mini cakes were said to be created by Italian immigrants to evoke the colors of their home country’s flag. So pretty!

Get the Italian Rainbow Cookies recipe.

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below
3

White Chocolate Macadamia Cookies

Dot the tops of these irresistibly buttery cookies with more chopped nuts and chocolate before baking for extra-pretty, portrait-worthy treats. Smile!

Get the White Chocolate Macadamia Cookies recipe.

4

Ciambelline al Vino (Wine Cookies)

These rustic Italian sugar-coated knots are made with wine — but the party doesn't end there! Dunk them in a glass of vino to mark the sweet finale of your meal.

Get the Ciambelline al Vino (Wine Cookies) recipe.

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below
5

Black & White Cookies

These cakey, dual-toned cookies will be the first to go at any cookie swap. Lemon zest in the batter adds a touch of balanced brightness.

Get the Black & White Cookies recipe.

6

Hermit Bars

True to their name, these gingerbread-like bars are the perfect excuse to stay inside for an entire day (or two). A cup of strong coffee—or even a snifter of brandy—would be a welcome pairing.

Get the Hermit Bars recipe.

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below
7

Pandan Checkerboard Cookies

Original? Yes. Delicious? Also yes. Infused with mellow, vanilla-like pandan extract, these green-and-white checkerboard cookies are guaranteed to make a splash at your cookie swap.

Get the Pandan Checkerboard Cookies recipe.

8

9

Strawberry Pinwheels

These pinwheel cookies incorporate strawberry powder for a 100% natural, vibrant red hue. Plus, they make us think of santa—win-win.

Get the Strawberry Pinwheels recipe.

10

Danish Butter Cookies

Pipe these tender, ultra-buttery treats into different shapes for a delicious, gift-worthy assortment (you can even put them in a blue tin!).

Get the Danish Butter Cookies recipe.

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below
11

Chocolate Peppermint Cookies

A splash of peppermint extract gives these dark chocolate-dipped cookies just the right amount of minty flavor. Top ‘em off with crushed candy canes for that extra-festive touch.

Get the Chocolate Peppermint Cookies recipe.

12

Speculoos Dippers

Can you have too much speculoos? We can’t say for sure—but we’re also the ones who came up with this duo of homemade speculoos dippers and speculoos butter, so we’re probably not the best people to ask.

Get the Speculoos Dippers recipe.

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below
13

Razzle-Dazzles

These peppy pink cookies are filled with pulverized freeze-dried raspberries, giving them a subtle tartness that’ll stand out from all the other rich, buttery treats on your holiday table.

Get the Razzle-Dazzles recipe.

14

Chocolate-Dipped Cookie Sticks

These dipped cookie sticks give us as much joy as a kid opening presents on Christmas morning. Feel free to switch up the coatings: we love combining hazelnuts with chocolate for a Baci-like bite.

Get the Chocolate-Dipped Cookie Sticks recipe.

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below
15

Waffle Cookies With Strawberry Buttercream

Upgrade store-bought waffle cookies by sandwiching them with a pretty pink frosting tinted with freeze-dried strawberries. Last-minute dessert, done!

Get the Waffle Cookies With Strawberry Buttercream recipe.

RELATED: 12 Most Popular Types of Frosting

16

Nut Butter Ritz Sandwiches

Sweet, salty and totally unique, these chocolate-dipped sandwich cookies take the humble butter cracker to the next level. A honey-sweetened banana and almond butter filling is the perfect pairing.

Get the Nut Butter Ritz Sandwiches recipe.

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below
17

Pistachio Florentines

A subtle green tint from pistachios makes these crisp, chewy cookies look extra festive, especially if you serve them on your most Christmas-y red platter.

Get the Pistachio Florentines recipe.

18

Pecan Berry Bursts

Processing freeze-dried berries with confectioners’ sugar creates a vibrant, flavorful dusting for homemade pecan cookies.

Get the Pecan Berry Bursts recipe.

RELATED: What Is Confectioners' Sugar?

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below
19

Moss Cookies

These whimsical, cookie-crumb-topped cookies are giving enchanted forest vibes and will add something fresh (and super cute) to your cookie spread.

Get the Moss Cookies recipe.

20

Brown Butter Crispy Rice Treats

These crispy treats are sort of a cheat (they're not really cookies), but we're always thrilled to see them as part of a cookie spread. Brown butter elevates your childhood fave and makes them a little extra moreish.

Get the Brown Butter Crispy Rice Treats recipe.

Joy Cho
Assistant Food Editor

Joy (she/her) is an assistant food editor in the Good Housekeeping Test Kitchen, where she develops and tests recipes to ensure both deliciousness and accuracy before they appear in titles like Good Housekeeping, Women’s Health, Woman’s Day, Prevention and Country Living. After graduating from UChicago with a major in political science, she made the (best) decision to pursue her passion for food by enrolling in pastry school and working at her dream restaurant, Gramercy Tavern. Before joining the GH team, Joy assisted on cookbook and editorial shoots, ran an Instagram micro bakery, and worked as a freelance writer and developer with bylines appearing in Eater, Food52, Simply Recipes, Food Network and more. Joy has a special place in her heart for croissants and tiramisu, and is always on the hunt for the next cafe to explore in the city (a journey that never ends!).
